parrafo_1.es: Branch-Out Landscape & Property Maintenance es un equipo de Homestead que cuida jardines residenciales y comerciales. Jose y su equipo trabajan con cuidado alrededor de decoracion, mangueras y riego.
parrafo_1.en: Branch-Out Landscape & Property Maintenance is a Homestead based crew that cares for residential and commercial yards. Jose and his team work carefully around decor, hoses and sprinklers.

parrafo_2.es: Corte de cesped, poda de setos, retiro de arboles y arbustos viejos, y reparacion de riego. Terminamos y nos llevamos los desechos.
parrafo_2.en: Lawn mowing, hedge trimming, removal of old trees and shrubs, and irrigation repair. We finish the job and haul the debris away.

texto.es: Nos cuentas que necesita tu jardin. Jose responde directo, sin formularios ni intermediarios.
texto.en: Tell us what your yard needs. Jose answers directly, no forms, no middlemen.

texto.es: Vemos el cesped, los setos y los arboles antes de dar un precio.
texto.en: We look at the lawn, hedges and trees before giving a price.

texto.es: Precio justo segun el trabajo, sin sorpresas al final.
texto.en: A fair price based on the job, no surprises at the end.

texto.es: Trabajamos con cuidado alrededor de tu decoracion y riego, y nos llevamos los desechos.
texto.en: We work carefully around your decor and sprinklers, and haul the debris away.

nota.es: Cada jardin se cotiza segun su tamano y lo que necesite. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every yard is quoted based on size and scope. Call and we will give you a price, no strings attached.

texto.es: Corte, bordeado y mantenimiento regular de cesped para que tu jardin se vea cuidado todo el ano.
texto.en: Mowing, edging and regular lawn maintenance so your yard stays sharp all year.

texto.es: Poda de setos y arbustos con lineas limpias, trabajando con cuidado alrededor de tu decoracion.
texto.en: Hedge and shrub trimming with clean lines, working carefully around your decor.

texto.es: Retiro de arboles y arbustos viejos para abrir espacio en tu jardin.
texto.en: Removal of old trees and shrubs to open up space in your yard.

texto.es: Revision y reparacion de aspersores y tuberias de riego danadas.
texto.en: Inspection and repair of broken sprinkler heads and irrigation lines.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llama igual, cubrimos mas de mantenimiento de propiedad.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call anyway, we cover more property maintenance than this.

items.quote: Jose and his team always do a great job landscaping my backyard. They work carefully around decor, hoses, sprinklers, and solar lights. They will trim trees and bushes upon request and will haul away debris afterwards.

I highly recommend this company. I have used them a few times already and I'm very satisfied with their lawn care services. Jose is very friendly, professional and the best part is the excellent communication.

Very good experience with Jose and his team. They dug out some old trees and plants from the corner of my house to make room for a new fence and did a great job. Pleasant to work with and a fair price. Would definitely work with them again.
